title: Chapter 50
text: ∫ consummation I come down the stairway and she asks, “did you write some little poems?” “yes,” I answer. I sit next to her on the couch and we both look at the t.v. screen. it’s David Letterman. “all the cats are in except Beeker,” she says. “I’ll look for him,” I say. I get up and go outside and clap my hands and yell, “Beeker! Beeker! come on, Beeker!” 4 or 5 people in this working-class neighborhood curse me from under their sheets. Beeker comes slowly from another yard. he clambers the fence. he’s fat. he drops, grunts and we walk toward the door together, enter. I lock the door, turn as Letterman vanishes into a commercial. Butch
